notes: Nill Download Manager 2.1.1 is a correctness release for the native interface, fixing everything a full hands-on audit of 2.1.0 turned up. The download list can no longer scramble its rows when downloads are added, finished and deleted in sequence; a failed add — a dead link, a 404 — no longer leaves a phantom row behind; a direct link to a video file now keeps its video handling instead of being treated as a plain file; after an error, the progress dialog shows exactly what is really on disk — real downloaded amount, real percentage, honest resume capability — instead of stale figures; and an unreachable host now fails cleanly inside a clear bound instead of hanging in a probing state. Smaller fixes in the same pass: the progress dialog's connection table shows every row, paused downloads are labelled "Paused", and error messages are written in plain language. The retired WebView-era code — about 58,000 lines — has also been removed from the repository; app behaviour is otherwise unchanged from 2.1.0. The downloading engine itself was audited byte for byte and needed no changes.
